_comment: Editorial content for ICIBL. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. ICIBL is an operating investment bank, not a fund. No image is attached.
description: Invest Capital Investment Bank Limited is a Pakistani investment bank that dates its presence in the financial services sector to 1994 and serves institutions, corporates, high-net-worth individuals, intermediaries and government organisations. Its services span corporate finance and advisory — equity and debt placements, mergers and acquisitions, structured finance and private equity — as well as equity and commodities brokerage, portfolio management, and business and consumer lending. The company's head office is in Lahore and its registered office in Karachi.
